metadata.title: Docetaxel Monotherapy 50 mg/m² – 14 day cycle
metadata.indication: Docetaxel with prednisone/prednisolone for hormone-refractory metastatic prostate cancer.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled draft; independent approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current official sources reconciled with recorded ambiguities; independent clinical and pharmacy approval outstanding.

source_discrepancies: The printed 50% hepatic-dose row has ambiguous boundaries. No automatic hepatic percentage is calculated; specialist reconciliation is required.
No universal platelet 100 ×10⁹/L treatment threshold is specified in this source; the old generic platelet hold has been removed.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by the appropriately qualified Consultant specified in the NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification or non-standard continuation should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Source-reconciled feasibility encoding for NCCP 00313 v5. Current official sources, consultant prescribing decisions and pharmacy verification remain required.

platelets_x10e9_l.label: Platelets
platelets_x10e9_l.assessment_guidance: NCCP 00313 does not specify a platelet dose threshold. Review the full blood count clinically; no platelet-based dose is calculated here.

renal_input.reason: The NCCP source expects no renal dose adjustment, including haemodialysis. This optional value records renal monitoring and is not a Calvert calculation.

premedication_completed.label: Prescribed dexamethasone premedication completed / approved alternative confirmed

new_or_worsening_pulmonary_symptoms.label: New or worsening pulmonary symptoms
new_or_worsening_pulmonary_symptoms.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough, breathlessness or hypoxia. This flags symptoms for diagnosis; it does not establish docetaxel-induced lung disease.

suspected_serious_bowel_toxicity.label: Suspected serious bowel toxicity / enterocolitis
suspected_serious_bowel_toxicity.assessment_guidance: Clinically assess significant abdominal pain, fever, diarrhoea or other concerning gastrointestinal symptoms. Neutropenic enterocolitis can occur at any cycle; no automatic diagnosis is made.

suspected_severe_cutaneous_reaction.label: Suspected SJS / TEN / AGEP or other severe cutaneous reaction
suspected_severe_cutaneous_reaction.assessment_guidance: Record clinical suspicion of a serious skin reaction, distinct from the ordinary graded skin-toxicity dose table. Confirm diagnosis and specialist plan.

action.recommendation: SOURCE AMBIGUITY: normal bilirubin with AST/ALT >1.5–5 and ALP >2.5–5 suggests considering 75% of ORIGINAL dose; the printed 50% row overlaps / leaves gaps. Consultant/pharmacy must resolve the pattern, including ALP exactly 6. No automatic 50% / 75% dose is calculated.

action.recommendation: Treat the acute event and confirm recovery. Subsequent source ladder is 50 →40 mg/m²; discontinue if recurrence at the lower dose.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic impairment / significant hepatic dysfunction is a source chemotherapy exclusion. Do not administer affected chemotherapy; review docetaxel and the separate steroid plan.

action.recommendation: Persistent grade 3 skin toxicity at 40 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

rules.explanation: Persistent grade 3 skin toxicity at 40 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

action.recommendation: A documented ANC <0.5 episode lasting more than one week affects the subsequent dose even after counts recover: source ladder 50 →40 mg/m²; recurrence at the lower dose requires discontinuation. Confirm recovery and actual dose before restarting.

rules.explanation: A documented ANC <0.5 episode lasting more than one week affects the subsequent dose even after counts recover: source ladder 50 →40 mg/m²; recurrence at the lower dose requires discontinuation. Confirm recovery and actual dose before restarting.

action.recommendation: Do not begin infusion until the team has reconciled missed/contraindicated dexamethasone premedication. The 20 mg IV alternative is a consultant choice, not an automatic substitute.

action.recommendation: Stop docetaxel immediately and treat the severe reaction. The NCCP source advises no rechallenge after a severe hypersensitivity reaction.

action.recommendation: Interrupt docetaxel pending prompt investigation of new or worsening pulmonary symptoms. Consider infection, progression, embolism and treatment-related lung disease; review the benefit of resuming after a diagnosis is available.

administration.dose: 10 mg once daily OR 5 mg twice daily

dose_reductions: 50 → 40 mg/m²; persistent qualifying toxicity at the lower dose: discontinue
treatment.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; individual plan.

baseline: Full blood count, renal and liver profile
regular: Full blood count, renal and liver profile before treatment; review symptoms, neuropathy, skin/mouth toxicity and fluid retention.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Docetaxel is low emetogenic risk; the regimen also requires its protocol-specific corticosteroid premedication.
supportive_care.premedications: Dexamethasone 8 mg orally at 12 hours, 3 hours and 1 hour before docetaxel. If omitted, consultant may consider dexamethasone 20 mg IV immediately before; this is not an automatic substitution.
supportive_care.growth_factor: G-CSF may be used according to patient/regimen risk and NCCP guidance.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk

indications.description: Advanced prostate cancer treated with docetaxel 50 mg/m² every 14 days.

administration.notes: Infuse over 60 minutes; confirm the prescribed dose and any source-supported reduction.
Continuous daily steroid; the source also permits 5 mg twice daily. Follow the prescription and do not stop abruptly.
